# Composer & transcript

Richer prompts and replies: @ references, model and effort, plan cards, diagrams, HTML and test cards, tool timing, turn summaries and a side chat.

Pack id `transcript`. Back to [all packs](README.md).

## Plugins

1. [`@dshfiles/mentions`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/mentions/README.md) — One ranked @ menu for files and threads, with @thread: and @file: scopes, replacing the native reference source.
2. [`@dshfiles/model-effort-picker`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/model-effort-picker/README.md) — Pick models across accounts, tune reasoning effort and enable Fast mode on supported routes.
3. [`@dshfiles/annotations`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/annotations/README.md) — Element-linked visual feedback: pick a UI element, get its source, and put a bounded note in the draft.
4. [`@dshfiles/agent-plan`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/agent-plan/README.md) — Agent work you can read at a glance: todo_write as a plan card with step N of M and per-step timing, the current step pinned by the composer, a live strip of running tools, jobs and subagents, and Retry / Ask to fix on failed turns.
5. [`@dshfiles/mermaid-diagrams`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/mermaid-diagrams/README.md) — Renders ```mermaid fences in the chat transcript as themed diagrams, loading the renderer only when a diagram first shows.
6. [`@dshfiles/html-render`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/html-render/README.md) — Agent tool html_render: a self-contained HTML page shown in the chat transcript as a sandboxed, themed card.
7. [`@dshfiles/test-runs`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/test-runs/README.md) — Vitest runs in the chat transcript as a test-results card: per-file results, assertion diffs, code frames, and Ask to fix.
8. [`@dshfiles/attachment-gallery`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/attachment-gallery/README.md) — Owned attachment presentation with keyboard-navigable image galleries.
9. [`@dshfiles/tool-meta`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/tool-meta/README.md) — Start time and duration on every tool call in the chat transcript, counting live while the call runs.
10. [`@dshfiles/turn-summary`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/turn-summary/README.md) — A one-line summary under each finished turn: commands run and which failed, files edited, reads and searches. Every part can be switched off.
11. [`@dshfiles/btw`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/btw/README.md) — /btw opens a side chat about the current thread: a cache-friendly fork in a right-sidebar panel, archived on close.

## Prerequisites

None.

## Key settings

None.

## Enable it

1. In the app: **Knowledge › Getting started**, then **Enable pack** on Composer & transcript under Packs. It previews exactly what changes; **Disable pack** reverses it.
2. From an Agent: the `onboarding_pack_apply` tool with pack `transcript`. It runs only when you ask, after showing the preview.
3. From a shell: `dshx init --profile <name> --packs transcript` (Core is added; `--dry-run` previews). See [`dshx init`](../../tooling/dshx/docs/cli-reference.md#dshx-init-compose-a-profile-from-packs).

## Restart

Installing a plugin the profile does not have yet needs a DSH Host restart: DSH reads the profile once at boot. Plugins already installed are switched on in the running DSH. Nothing restarts on its own: use **Restart when idle** in the sidebar when DSH runs under the managed launcher, otherwise your own launcher.
